a_owned_registration.placement: beside the existing feature-router imports and include_router calls
before the wildcard Route so the standalone classroom does not render App

route_registry_note.reason: The dedicated route uses the exported feature constant and must not be added to MENTORFLOW_ROUTES, whose entries all render App. A may extend the shared registry only if its contract is changed deliberately.

provider_runtime.selection: Use an explicitly requested verified ProviderRuntime session, otherwise use the latest verified non-fake session; with no verified real session create an explicitly labelled DEMO_FAKE classroom.
provider_runtime.native_provider_streaming_contract: true only when the verified ProviderRuntime handle exposes stream_text; existing text-only handles make one real text call and then emit local SSE chunks with native_provider_streaming=false
provider_runtime.secrets_boundary: The public session, events, diagnostics, QA evidence, and errors must never contain credentials, raw keys, raw cache keys, the prompt envelope, or raw provider payloads.

required_environment_and_configuration.demo: None; the five-turn fixture is offline and uses zero Provider calls.
required_environment_and_configuration.real: An existing verified ProviderRuntime session and its normal credential-store entry. No credential or key is accepted by the Teacher Live API request schema.

integration_smoke_checks: POST /api/teacher-live/sessions with no verified real session returns provider_label=DEMO_FAKE and demo_fixture=true
Submit one fixture turn and observe turn_started, incremental response_chunk events, citation, metrics, and completed
Open /teacher-live and verify the provider badge, current concept, send, pause/resume, abort, citation toggle, closed diagnostics, and safe retry
acceptance_boundary: Offline module, contract, UI, and fake-stream behavior are ready. Real-provider performance and capability observations remain pending under the nonblocking QA request and must not be inferred from offline results.
